d:
You won't believe how this man catches fish! In today's village life vlog, we travel to the beautiful region of Ghatshila, India, to witness one of the most amazing and risky fishing techniques we have ever seen. Watch as this brave fisherman risks the fast, deep river current to make a stunning, big catch.
This video offers a true, authentic look at the daily struggles and unbelievable skills of local fishermen in village life in India.
What You’ll See:
The extreme risk of the river jump (The Hook)
The unique local fishing method
The incredible final result!
